Roundtable
×

Configure the multi-model review panels — the “roundtables” aimee convenes.

Each preset sets the seats (a model + a persona per seat), the aggregator, and the

loop knobs (rounds, convergence, deadline, turns) plus authoring-pipeline caps.

Save several named presets and pick one as the active default.

See also: Models →
Got it
Roundtable
active: default
Roundtable behaviour

These apply to every panel, whichever preset is active. (Seats, limits, and the pipeline caps are per preset — set those below.)

Require evidence roundtable.require_evidence
Panelists must cite evidence for their findings; unevidenced items are dropped when the panel is verified.
Replay-verify findings roundtable.replay_verify_enabled
After a panel completes, replay its findings to verify them before they are reported.
Chair synthesis roundtable.chair_synthesis
The chair writes a synthesis pass over the panel's output instead of returning the raw per-seat results.
Presets
(1)

A roundtable is a panel of models, each playing a persona, that review or draft together. Configure several named presets and pick one as the active default — the active preset drives what aimee delegate roundtable convenes.

Roundtable policy is read-only to agents and automation. Creating, editing, deleting, or selecting the default requires an authenticated appliance-administrator action from this UI.

Every typed config option with plain-English help.

Booleans are toggles, numbers are fields, strings are text; restart-sensitive keys are badged.

This is the full control plane the setup wizard walks you through a slice of.

See also: Dashboard →

Reload
Replay tab tutorials
Re-run setup

Changes persist to aimee.yaml and take effect on the next turn, unless a row is marked restart. The everyday runtime options are shown by default; deploy-time, advanced-tuning, and dev-only options are hidden behind Show advanced (still settable, and any of them surfaces when you search). Each option is described below.

Options owned by another tab are configured there, not here: Chat tab / Personas tab · Models tab · Pipeline page (kb console) · Settings page (kb console). Each option has one owner, so a value set in its own tab is never silently overwritten by an edit made here.

Agent behavior
(15)

How autonomously aimee runs, per-turn limits, and fix verification.

Autonomous
autonomous
Launch the agent CLI with its full autonomous flags, relying on aimee's guardrails for safety. Off by default.
Cross verify
cross_verify
Have delegates check the primary's fixes and the primary check delegates' fixes. Off by default.
Max iterations
max_iterations
Max tool-call rounds in one interactive turn. 0 uses the default (15).
Max iterations delegate
max_iterations_delegate
Max tool-call rounds in one delegate turn. 0 uses the default (25).
Reasoning cap enabled
reasoning_cap_enabled
Lower the reasoning effort on simple turns automatically. Only ever lowers, never raises. Off by default.
Reasoning datalog command
reasoning_datalog_command
Reasoning row budget
reasoning_row_budget
Reasoning time limit ms
reasoning_time_limit_ms
Trigger max concurrent
trigger_max_concurrent
Trigger rule count
trigger_rule_count
Verify cmd
verify_cmd
Verify cross project
verify_cross_project
Let verify run and enforce across other repositories, not just the session's own. Off by default.
Verify enabled
verify_enabled
Automatically gate pushes and PRs and generate an enforcing project.yaml. Off by default — only repos with an explicit enforcing project.yaml are gated. Manual 'aimee git verify' still works either way.
